findings.issue: The table now picks which hole cards to show from table.config.userSeat, but draws them under whichever seat has kind 'user'. nextStep and applyUserAction also go by config.userSeat. If a future config had userSeat pointing at a bot seat (userSeat !== the 'user'-kind seat), that bot's hole cards would show face up under the user's seat, and the user would act for that bot. That breaks REQ-025. Nothing in this slice can reach it: the only config producer is the constant DEFAULT_SESSION_CONFIG, and nothing reads URL, query, storage or network. The spec accepts this as A-11, with follow-up F-4.
findings.evidence: No untrusted input today. App.tsx passes DEFAULT_SESSION_CONFIG to GameConfigScreen, which passes the same object to onStart, then TableScreen, then seatSession(resolveSessionConfig). Table.tsx:16 calls hand.players.find(p => p.seat === table.config.userSeat).holeCards and renders them under the seat with s.kind === 'user'.
findings.fix: No change needed in this story. When the first config loader lands (TASK-2.6/3.10, F-4), validate in resolveSessionConfig/seatSession: exactly one 'user' seat, its seat === userSeat, players === seats.length, button among the seats. Fail closed with a RangeError.

summary: No BLOCKER or MAJOR findings. External requests: none added. No web font or CDN; the Google Fonts link was dropped (A-5). The CSS uses the system-ui stack. The only http URLs in src are the existing SVG xmlns attributes. The logo is src/assets/tlh-logo.jpg, which was already tracked at the base commit. It is imported through Vite, so it is served from the app's own origin. SessionConfig comes only from the DEFAULT_SESSION_CONFIG constant through in-memory React state. No location, URLSearchParams, localStorage, sessionStorage, fetch or import.meta.env reads exist in src. No package or lockfile changes, so no new dependencies. Production src imports no test helpers or test libraries. useHeadingFocus only sets tabIndex and calls focus(). Fairness (REQ-025) is unchanged: stepBot still acts through actWith/policy on the bot's own view; the user's PlayerView, action bar and shown hole cards now key on config.userSeat, which equals USER_SEAT in the default; bot seats still render name and stack only, never hole cards. The one MINOR is defence in depth for when configs become user-supplied. No scanners or Vitest runs were started.
